en: Check the mirror, look over your shoulder, then tap the green button
zh: 先看镜子，再回头，没车就点绿色按钮

en: Getting out: look before you open
Nobody there this time. Next time there might be.
zh: 这次旁边没车，下次可能有。

en: It was in your left blind spot. The mirror can\'t show it.
zh: 它在你左后方的盲区里，镜子里看不到。

en: It was in your right blind spot. The mirror can\'t show it.
zh: 它在你右后方的盲区里，镜子里看不到。

en: It was right there in the mirror. Just wait a beat.
zh: 镜子里就有它，再等一下就好。

en: A bike was coming up beside you. Look back before the door.
zh: 身后有车骑过来，开门前回头看。

en: There was a gap. Go when you\'ve checked.
zh: 刚才有空档，看清了就走。

en: Use your far hand. Your body turns on its own.
zh: 开门用远侧手，身体自然会转过去。

en: Eye tracking is off: mirror checks use head direction
zh: 眼动没开：看镜子按头的方向算

en: Turn on eye tracking? Then we can tell which mirror you looked at.
zh: 开眼动？这样能认出你看了哪面镜子。

en: 2 stars on the level before unlocks it
zh: 上一关拿到 2 星解锁

en: Next: tap Start, check the mirror, look back, go when it\'s clear.
zh: 接下来：点开始，看镜子、回头，没车就走。
今日挑战 · 今日最好 %1$s

en: Shoulder Check 0.2.0 · offline, no account. Traffic rules: check the mirror and look over your shoulder before you change lanes, merge, pull out or open the door.
zh: 盲区回头 0.2.0 · 全离线、无账号。交规要求：变道、并线、起步、开车门前，先看后视镜，再回头看盲区。

en: Clear all scores? This can\'t be undone.
zh: 清除所有成绩？不能恢复。

en: Hands: just turn your head; your eyes are tracked
zh: 手势：转头就行，眼睛会被识别

en: Controller: the same, just turn your head
Hands: look at the green button and pinch, or point the hand ray and pinch
zh: 手势：看着绿色按钮捏一下，或用手势射线指着捏

en: Controller: point and pull the trigger, or press A
zh: 手柄：射线指着按扳机，或直接按 A 键

en: Hands: pinch the inner door handle (or reach and touch it)
zh: 手势：看着车门内把手捏一下（也可以伸手碰它）

en: Controller: point at the handle and pull the trigger, or press A
zh: 手柄：射线指着把手按扳机，或按 A 键

en: Hands: pinch 「Pause」 above the steering wheel
zh: 手势：看着方向盘上方的「暂停」捏一下
手柄：按 Y 键或 B 键

en: Restart this game? Its score is not kept.
zh: 重来这局？这局的分数不保留。

en: Back to practice? This game\'s score is not kept.
zh: 回到练习页？这局的分数不保留。

en: Today\'s run: this round counts as played.
zh: 今日挑战：这一轮算已玩。

en: Tracking lost. Look around the room, then continue.
zh: 头显跟丢了，看一圈房间再继续。

en: Full Space is needed to look behind you.
zh: 需要全空间才能回头看后面。

en: Bring the window back to front
